brief.industry_meta: AI Infrastructure · Open-Source AI Cloud / Inference
brief.deck: Together AI, the San Francisco cloud built for open-source AI, closed an $800M Series C at an $8.3B valuation on 1 July 2026, led by Aramco Ventures with Nvidia, Vista and General Catalyst: two and a half times its February 2025 price, with annual bookings past $1.15B.
brief.the_case_p1: Together AI announced on 1 July 2026 an $800M Series C at an $8.3B post-money valuation, led by Aramco Ventures with Vista Equity Partners, General Catalyst, Emergence Capital, Nvidia, March Capital, Pegatron and S Ventures. Annual bookings topped $1.15B in the last quarter, with thousands of paying customers including Cursor, Cognition and Decagon. The $305M Series B at $3.3B, led by General Catalyst, closed only in February 2025. The company says its infrastructure footprint will grow roughly 50-fold over five years: for an infrastructure business, the brand-building moment arrives with the build-out.
brief.the_case_p2: The grid has already priced the neocloud archetype: CoreWeave became Aston Martin Aramco's Official AI Cloud Computing Partner in May 2025, Core Scientific and TWG AI opened on Cadillac's first roster, and Groq holds inference silicon on McLaren's. Aramco, the lead investor here, is both F1's Global Partner and the Aston Martin title, so the ecosystem knows the name; the seat, though, has to be one CoreWeave does not already hold.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The round closed on 1 July; brand budgets are set in the quarter after a raise, and a 50-fold capacity plan needs a name enterprises recognise. Teams fix 2027 rosters in the fourth quarter; the United States GP (Austin, October) and Las Vegas GP (November) are the stages for a US announcement.
brief.why_team_para: Haas is the American team, run from Kannapolis, North Carolina, racing in 2026 as TGR Haas F1 Team under Toyota Gazoo Racing's title partnership. Its technology roster is IT services, networking and communications: Mphasis, CommScope, Ruckus, Infobip. There is no cloud, GPU or AI-compute partner, so Official AI Cloud Partner is a clean category at the grid's most accessible price. A San Francisco developer brand gets a US home team, three US rounds and engineers who will use the product.
brief.value_section_label: VALUE TO TGR HAAS F1 TEAM
brief.value_content: MODE A - operational. A team without a hyperscaler partner buys compute at list price. Together's self-service GPU clusters spin up in minutes for machine-learning surrogates, strategy and driver-in-loop simulation, and telemetry analytics between sessions; private open-model inference gives engineers assistants that keep team data in-house. In return: a named compute partnership, sidepod presence, and Miami, Austin and Las Vegas hospitality for Together's enterprise buyers.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official AI Cloud Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, spanning the 50-fold build-out and a probable listing window. Estimated $3-5M a year, part-payable in compute credits. Scope: sidepod or engine-cover placement, naming of the team's compute environment, US-round hospitality, engineering content.
brief.decision_maker_bio: Prakash co-founded Together AI in 2022 after selling Topsy to Apple and leading search and AI for Siri; a first sports partnership is his call. Path: Kai Mak, Chief Revenue Officer, Charles Zedlewski, Chief Product Officer, Meicheng Shi, SVP Finance. No chief marketing officer is listed.

why_team.label: The ecosystem path

value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)

# Together AI → TGR Haas F1 Team — verification log (N° 170, issued for 1 Jul 2026)

Built in-session on 6 Sep 2026 at no API cost (no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), with Claude acting as scanner, verifier and writer through the pipeline's injectable stages; the calendar table, sponsor table, 13-rule audit and the 2-page render ran as code from `togetherai.case.json`. **Sandbox limitation, stated plainly:** direct fetches of together.ai, businesswire.com, prnewswire.com, techcrunch.com and haasf1team.com were blocked by the egress proxy. Each claim below was checked against the search summary of the primary page named as the evidence URL. Treat every VERIFIED line as REPORTED until a person opens the link. ## The trigger, and the correction to the thin row

The round is company-announced (Business Wire, 1 Jul 2026) and Tier-1 covered (TechCrunch, Yahoo Finance, DCD the same day): **$800M Series C at $8.3B post-money, led by Aramco Ventures**. The thin row's framing, "Aramco Ventures lead investor creates direct FE / Jeddah E-Prix Gen4 ecosystem alignment", was the earlier writer's inference and does not survive the sponsor table: Aramco's motorsport money is in Formula 1 (championship Global Partner; Aston Martin title through 2028). The series is therefore F1, and the Aramco tie is treated as an ecosystem introduction, not a team path, because CoreWeave holds the AI-cloud lane at Aston Martin.
